items.label: Open top design with more brightness
items.value: This tall standing lamp assembled size is 10.3" L *10.3" W*63" H. It is designed with open top design to shed more light on your room.

items.label: 3 color temperature bulb with memory function
items.value: shelf lamp includes a 9 Watt, 800 lumen energy saving LED bulb. The LED bulb has 3 color temperatures: 2700K/4000K/5000K. You can switch different color temperatures by pulling the pull chain twice within 10 seconds. Also the led bulb has memory function, it will remember the light color last time you chose.

items.label: 3 tier storage and display
items.value: Our floor lamp with shelves is made of sturdy wood with stable structure, high loading with 50 lbs max loading capacity. This floor lamp adds ambiance to your room and provides a storage or display area for vases, books, plants, albums or other items.

items.label: Wide application
items.value: this shelf floor lamp is a perfect holiday gift and birthday gift for mothers, fathers, wives, husbands, children, and friends. It's suitable for beside a sofa, tv stand, fish tank in the living room, reading in the bedroom or reading room, office, library, kitchen, coffee shop, hotel, restaurant, etc.

items.label: Assemble easily in 10 mins
items.value: the package comes with the tools needed for assembly and an instruction manual containing text and video installation steps. Simply follow the steps to assemble the shleves and poles in 10 minutes.
